scope: PP2 world01-01 Warp and shared WarpComponent static semantics
coordinates: Source and native coordinates are Y-down. Actor position is feet-center for players; collision top-left is actor position plus(-16,-47), size32x46.
parameterEncoding: Numeric t=1 values become native FP Q16.16; other t values read as zero.

slots.4: destination offset x per warp counter
slots.5: destination offset y per warp counter

fieldPointerConvention: Value-type pointers use metadata boxed offsets minus16

collision.evidence: ParseParameter0x1817344ac..504 stores height=slot1,width=slot0 at component+0x38 and zeros localX/Y; InitCollision0x1817345c0..610 passes this rect to ActorComponent.CreateCollision then sets Collision.m_Layer at+1 to14.

ordinaryWarp.trigger: OnCollided receives collision; layer1 Player accepted. No button/action, direction, occupancy or actor-name condition is checked. Layers2 and8 also accepted; other layers ignored.
ordinaryWarp.playerDestination: base destination + destinationOffset*shared signed-byte m_Counter; counter starts0 on default component creation and advances(counter+1)%Frame.GetPlayerActorCount after each player collision event. Counter is shared by the Warp actor rather than bound to player identity.
ordinaryWarp.nearZeroSentinel: Native compares absolute rawFP destination components to4 (not 4 world units): if both are below4, base becomes contacted player's current actor position; if only x is below4, base x becomes player's current x. Explicit world01-01 destination does not use this sentinel.
ordinaryWarp.otherAcceptedLayerDestination: Layers2/8 receive base destination directly; offset/counter do not apply and counter does not advance.
ordinaryWarp.eventResponse: ActorComponent.OnRecvEvent event63 copies Position into m_WarpPos, applies IsDisableCorrentWarpPos to flagbit20, zeros m_WarpVelo and calls ResetVeloAll. warpProc clears collision contacts, SetPosForce(destination), assigns actual m_Velo from m_WarpVelo (zero), then clears pending warp position/velocity.
ordinaryWarp.warpPositionCorrection: When correction is enabled, player type27 in a stage with camera-scroll flag may clamp destination x to camera view left boundary; no player-foot offset is added to destination itself.
evidence: ActorComponent.warpProc0x18169e51e..654 applies pending position and zero velocity

world01_01.integration: Detect contact against player collision rect before a custom out-of-map death check. Set player actor anchor to destination, or collision top-left to(destinationX-16,destinationY-47); reset velocity and contacts. Source map height960 does not invalidate this original Warp at y1056.
world01_01.evidence: installed-stage-decoded.local.json st_w_01_01 actorCreateParamList index10, plus native methods and quantum-field-offsets.json
